_ground: 2026-08-05 static read. An inbox over v_alert_truth + alert_dismissals, a cron-produced AMC daily brief, and an anomaly panel behind compute_anomaly_signals. Chart chrome shared with analytics and shift-brain (an-/ah-/sb- cohort).

seams.name: cron <-> db (the brief and the automation log)

invariants.name: dismissed stays dismissed; undo restores one
invariants.oracle: a dismissed alert stays dismissed across reload and across a realtime push; un-dismissing restores exactly one

invariants.name: compute_anomaly_signals is idempotent per window
invariants.oracle: running compute_anomaly_signals twice for one window does not double the signals

invariants.name: the critical hero counts undismissed rows
invariants.oracle: the critical hero count equals what its own predicate returns over UNDISMISSED rows

invariants.name: one AMC brief per hive per day, dated
invariants.oracle: an AMC briefing is one per hive per day, for a stated date - no duplicate brief

invariants.name: a dismissal's scope is stated
invariants.oracle: a dismissal is scoped to its dismisser, or explicitly to the hive, AND the surface says which - one person quietly blinding the team is the failure mode

invariants.name: alerts/anomalies/briefings isolation incl. realtime
invariants.oracle: a foreign hive's alerts, anomalies and briefings are invisible - including through the realtime channel

domain_truths.name: severity means the same here as on hive/analytics
domain_truths.oracle: severity vocabulary is one vocabulary shared with hive and analytics - critical here is critical there

domain_truths.name: an anomaly states what, baseline, window
domain_truths.oracle: an anomaly states WHAT was anomalous, against WHAT baseline, over WHAT window

domain_truths.name: the brief states generation time AND data cutoff
domain_truths.oracle: the AMC brief states its generation time and its data cutoff - they are not the same instant

domain_truths.name: a threshold alert names threshold and current value
domain_truths.oracle: a threshold alert names the threshold crossed and the current value

domain_truths.name: 0 alerts distinguishes clear from not-computed
domain_truths.oracle: '0 alerts' distinguishes 'nothing wrong' from 'nothing computed yet'

domain_truths.name: every automation action names rule/when/what
domain_truths.oracle: every automation_log action is attributable: which rule, when, on what

domain_truths.name: alert age is shown
domain_truths.oracle: alert age is shown - a 40-day-old alert must not read like a fresh one

domain_truths.name: a parts-staging recommendation says why
domain_truths.oracle: a parts-staging recommendation says WHY that part - which asset, which failure mode
